The seventh season of ''[[Futurama]]'' consisted of 26 episodes [[split television season|split]] equally across two broadcast seasons: 7-A and 7-B. It premiered on [[Comedy Central]] on June 20, 2012. A box set containing the 13 episodes of Season 7-A was released as ''Futurama: Volume 7'' and another box set containing the 13 episodes of Season 7-B was released as ''Futurama: Volume 8''.<ref name="FutuVol7">{{cite web |url=http://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Futurama-Volume-7-Blu-ray/49285/#Overview |title=Futurama: Volume 7 Blu-ray |date=July 1, 2012 |access-date=July 1, 2012 |archive-date=May 3, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150503173654/http://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Futurama-Volume-7-Blu-ray/49285/#Overview |url-status=live}}</ref>

On April 22, 2013, Comedy Central announced that season 7 would be the final season of the series. The final episode aired on September 4, 2013.<ref name="finale">{{cite news |last=Snierson |first=Dan |title='Futurama' to end seven-season run on Sept. 4 -- EXCLUSIVE |url=http://insidetv.ew.com/2013/04/22/futurama-not-renewed-comedy-central/ |access-date=April 22, 2013 |publisher=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |date=April 22, 2013 |archive-date=April 22, 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130422150351/http://insidetv.ew.com/2013/04/22/futurama-not-renewed-comedy-central/ |url-status=dead}}</ref> Despite the fact that it was originally intended as the final season, [[Hulu]] greenlit an eighth season in February 2022, which premiered on July 24, 2023.<ref name="hulurevival">{{cite web |last=Goldberg |first=Lesley |title='Futurama' Revived at Hulu |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/futurama-revived-at-hulu-1235090020/ |website=The Hollywood Reporter |access-date=February 9, 2022 |date=February 9, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | first=Amanda|last=Lamadrid|title = Futurama Reboot Episode Titles Confirmed|url=https://screenrant.com/futurama-reboot-episode-titles-details/|website=[[Screen Rant]]| date=August 25, 2022|access-date=August 31, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Otterson |first=Joe |date=2023-05-18 |title='Futurama' Revival at Hulu Sets Premiere Date, Drops First Teaser |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/news/futurama-revival-hulu-premiere-date-1235616847/ |access-date=2023-05-20 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Episodes==
{{See also|List of Futurama episodes}}
Comedy Central chose to air some parts of season 7 out of production order. This list is depicted in production order as this is the order used in ''Volume 7'' and ''Volume 8'' and intended by the producers. According to the commentaries in ''Volume 7'', "[[31st Century Fox]]" (7ACV11) and "[[Viva Mars Vegas]]" (7ACV12) were aired out of the intended production order because Comedy Central wanted to advertise [[Patrick Stewart]] being in the broadcast season finale.
